summary: All 9 applicable online boxes were re-verified in one Quake II deathmatch on the dev-host server (q2dm1). Every box is named on the roster as Fleet<octet> and sends sustained packets, with 9 humans plus 3 bots filling 12 of 12 slots. .186 is NA (no 3D driver). The game was closed everywhere, and PROCLIST shows no quake2.exe.
issues: The graceful WM_CLOSE did not close quake2.exe on any XP box within 12 s, so all 8 were force-killed and .243 was PROCKILLed. Force-killing can leave a GL box at the game mode, and desktop modes were not re-read after the kill.
.243 Voodoo 2 pass-through and display state cannot be seen remotely (GDI is blind to it).
Server capacity: 9 human slots with 3 bots, so a 10th fleet box could not join without removing a bot.
